question: Who must never receive the teaching because of reviling Shiva or Kula Bhairava?
premises: Slandering Kula Bhairava disqualifies a person
inference: The teaching must not be given to revilers of Shiva or Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake or stand as a separate target
plain_english: O goddess, do not give it to one who reviles Shiva or slanders Kula Bhairava.
